import math
from collections import defaultdict

# collect all scopes
scope_titles = [n["title"] for n in doc["nodes"] if n.get("kind")=="list" and n.get("title","").startswith("Video ")]
len(scope_titles)
print("Number of video scopes:", len(scope_titles))

# helper: get all motion rows for a scope
def motion_rows(scope):
    for node in scope_nodes(doc, scope):
        if node.get("kind")=="table" and node.get("title").endswith(": Motion log"):
            return _parse_motion_log_table(node["table"])
    return []

# 1. Compute average speed decay per frame for all visible objects
speed_diffs = defaultdict(list)
frame_counts = defaultdict(int)
for scope in scope_titles:
    rows = motion_rows(scope)
    # sort by frame
    rows.sort(key=lambda r: (r["frame"], r["object"]))
    for k, grp in itertools.groupby(rows, key=lambda r: r["object"]):
        grp = list(grp)
        prev_speed = None
        for r in grp:
            if prev_speed is not None:
                diff = r["speed"] - prev_speed
                speed_diffs[k].append(diff)
            prev_speed = r["speed"]
            frame_counts[k] += 1

# average decay (negative means slowing)
avg_decay = {k: sum(v)/len(v) for k, v in speed_diffs.items() if v}
print("\nAverage speed change per frame for each object id:")
for k, v in list(avg_decay.items())[:5]:
    print(k, f"{v:.3f}")

# 2. Collision distance and velocity approach
collision_info = []
for scope in scope_titles:
    for ev in observed_events(doc, scope):
        if ev["kind"]=="collision":
            t = int(ev["time"])
            # find both objects' positions at that frame
            positions = {}
            rows = motion_rows(scope)
            for r in rows:
                if r["frame"]==t:
                    positions[r["object"]] = (float(r["x"]), float(r["y"]), float(r["vx"]), float(r["vy"]))
            # compute distance between centroids
            p1 = positions.get(ev["participants"][0])
            p2 = positions.get(ev["participants"][1])
            if p1 and p2:
                dist = math.dist(p1[:2], p2[:2])
                speed1 = math.hypot(p1[2], p1[3])
                speed2 = math.hypot(p2[2], p2[3])
                collision_info.append((scope, ev["time"], dist, speed1, speed2))
len(collision_info)
print("\nSample collision info (first 5):")
for ci in collision_info[:5]:
    print(ci)

# 3. Estimate object sizes assuming spheres/cylinders with radius 0.1 (arbitrary)
# For each collision, compute sum radius from distance - approximate; infer typical radius
radii_estimates = []
for _, t, dist, _, _ in collision_info:
    # assume each object has same radius r-> dist = 2r => r = dist/2
    radii_estimates.append(dist/2)
avg_radius = sum(radii_estimates)/len(radii_estimates) if radii_estimates else None
print("\nEstimated average radius from collisions (assuming spread):", avg_radius)

# 4. Deceleration per frame (speed change)
print("\nTypical deceleration magnitude (abs):", max(abs(v) for v in avg_decay.values()))

# 5. Time step: 1 frame = 1 unit
print("\nTime unit: 1 frame = 1 time unit.\n")
